values.meaning: Frost stacks required to cast and consumed
values.quote: '''Sejuani''' can cast ''Permafrost'' against an enemy with 4 stacks

values.meaning: duration Frost stacks last before refreshing/expiring
values.quote: stacking up to 4 times... for 5 seconds

values.meaning: duration a champion cannot regain Frost after stacks consumed
values.quote: Enemy champions cannot be affected by ''Frost'' for 8 seconds after having it consumed

mechanics.claim: Melee basic attacks (Sejuani's and nearby allies') apply on-hit stacks of Frost, which are consumed by Permafrost or Glacial Prison to enable/enhance those abilities.
mechanics.quote: basic attacks on-hit apply stacks of Frost to enemy champions, medium or large monsters, and large minions for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications and stacking up to 4 times

mechanics.claim: Permafrost resets Sejuani's basic attack timer.
mechanics.quote: Permafrost resets Sejuani's basic attack timer.

mechanics.claim: Frost stacks are not applied if the target is currently frozen/stunned by Fury of the North.
mechanics.quote: though not applying if the target is ''{{ai|Fury of the North|Sejuani|Frozen}}''

mechanics.claim: If the cast is canceled because the target becomes untargetable, dies, or leaves range/sight during the cast time, the ability still goes on cooldown and pays its cost.
mechanics.quote: If the target becomes untargetable, dies, or is too far away or no longer in sight during the cast time, this ability will cancel but still go on cooldown and pay its cost.

mechanics.claim: Frost stacks are not applied if the triggering basic attack is blocked.
mechanics.quote: Frost stacks will not be applied if the basic attack is blocked.
